Cost: 500eb (Expensive)

This new-age applicator is able to convert bio-medicines into easy to consume aerosols, doing away with the days of needing some big-brained doctor to heal a few scratches. Product warnings include incompatibility with certain cybernetic implants and a slight (by 96.6%) chance of installed medicines having their effectiveness marginally (by 50%) reduced. When “healthy” just won’t cut it, and you can’t afford a Trauma Team educational course.

This item is capable of holding a single dose of any Pharmaceutical or Street Drug. As long as the user has one free hand and easy access to their MaxDoc, as an Action, they can apply the dose to themselves even if they are not a Medtech. However, it cannot be used on any unwilling target, conscious or not, due to requiring voluntary inhalation to work.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Gear, Drugs, & Frames > General Gear).
